title: docs(skills): give the protocol rule’s CORRECT data-table fence the required `data` (objectui#12135)
body:
Fixes #12135
Clause-②: no

Landing repo objectui · surface `skills/**` (governed, Tier H: this PR stays draft until an authorized approver's review is on it, and the dispatching seat lands it). Dispatched by the skills seat of PM session `session_011u73oxZ5X95qrARPTeoU6v`; the claim comment on the card names this branch.

## What changed

- `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`, "Rule: No Schema Property Invention", the fence labelled "✅ CORRECT": the `data-table` node gains a one-row inline `data` array. `DataTableSchema` (`packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`) declares `data: z.array(z.any())` as required, so at base both authoring faces refused the very node the skill tells an agent to copy, with `data: Invalid input: expected array, received undefined`. The row uses the person the bundle's other `data-table` examples already use. The paragraph still teaches "no keys the spec does not declare"; the example now shows the two declared keys the node needs. Net +1 line.
- `.changeset/12135-protocol-correct-fence-data.md`: an empty-frontmatter declaration. `skills/**` ships through `npx skills add` and sits in no package's `files[]` (`git grep -n '"skills' -- 'packages/*/package.json'` answers nothing), so no package releases.

Nothing else moved: no checker, no gate, no marker line.

## D3 — every json/jsonc fence under `skills/objectui/**`, re-derived with both faces

Predicate: the one `scripts/check-doc-json-fences.mjs` (objectui#12127, merged) judges `content/docs` with — its exported `scanJsonFences` / `classifyFence` / `nodeTypesOf`, plus `StrictAnyComponentSchema.safeParse` and `AnyComponentSchema.safeParse` from the BUILT `packages/types/dist/zod/index.zod.js` — pointed at `skills/objectui/**` by a throwaway probe (not committed). The gate's two controls held on every run (the undeclared-key control refused, the plain-button control accepted).

Population at base `9b75509`: 70 fences · 48 node documents · 18 with no `type` key · 3 not an object · 1 unresolved `type` (`module`, a package.json excerpt) · 0 unparseable. Refused: 9 by the strict face, 6 by the tolerant face. At head `d2619ba`: 8 and 5. The one row that moved is the last one below. Fences are cited by their lead-in text, not by line address (AGENTS.md commandment 11: a PR body has no same file).

| guide | tag | type | lead-in or label | strict | tolerant | first refusal reason | class |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| guides/schema-expressions.md | jsonc | card | `// Evaluated, then dropped -- renders an empty card` | refuse | accept | at (root): undeclared key "props" | counter-example |
| guides/schema-expressions.md | jsonc | text | `// value is RETIRED from text -- refused by name; write content` | refuse | refuse | at value: RETIRED (ADR-0049) — `value` is no longer part of TextSchema; write `content` | counter-example |
| guides/schema-expressions.md | jsonc | list | `// ❌ Renders two EMPTY li. children is not a template` | refuse | refuse | at children: REFUSED (objectui#9256, ADR-0049) — `list` reads NEITHER content channel | counter-example |
| guides/schema-expressions.md | jsonc | text | `// ❌ Refused by name — value is RETIRED from text; write content` (under "Expression shows as literal text") | refuse | refuse | at value: RETIRED (ADR-0049) | counter-example |
| guides/schema-expressions.md | jsonc | text | `// ❌ Worse — evaluated inside the envelope, then discarded` | refuse | accept | at (root): undeclared key "props" | counter-example |
| guides/schema-expressions.md | jsonc | text | `// ❌ Object literals not supported` (`style` carried as a string) | refuse | refuse | at style: Invalid input: expected record, received string | counter-example |
| rules/protocol.md | json | card | **❌ WRONG — renders an empty card** | refuse | accept | at (root): undeclared key "props" | counter-example |
| rules/protocol.md | jsonc | data-table | **Example violation** (`fields` + `customProp`) | refuse | refuse | at data: expected array, received undefined; then at columns; then undeclared keys "fields", "customProp" | counter-example |
| rules/protocol.md | jsonc | data-table | **✅ CORRECT** | refuse → **accept** | refuse → **accept** | at data: Invalid input: expected array, received undefined (base only) | the defect; repaired here |

The defect class — a fence labelled correct that the strict face refuses — has exactly one instance in the bundle, so no other file is touched.

## D4 — the `os:check` HTML-comment marker on json/jsonc fences: kept, because the dispatch's mechanism assumption did not survive measurement

The dispatch's default was to take that marker off every json/jsonc fence, on the reading that nothing judges it. Measured on `9b75509`, the reading is false:

- `grep -rn "os:check" scripts/ .github/workflows/ packages/*/scripts` hits exactly one program, `scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs` (its `MARKER` constant), plus that script's own test. The script declares `JSON_FENCE_LANGUAGES = new Set(['json', 'jsonc'])` three lines under the `TS_FENCE_LANGUAGES` the card quotes; it parses every MARKED json fence (`jsonc` with comments and trailing commas stripped), reports a marker that opts nothing in as an orphan, and holds the marked population under `MARKED_FLOOR`, whose row `['json', 70]` carries the comment "39 to 70 (objectui#7474)" and is ⛔ SHRINK-ONLY. The workflow `skill-examples.yml` (check name "Skill Example Check") runs it on every PR.
- The gate's own summary at head: "Marked: 18 ts fence(s) (floor 13), 70 json fence(s) (floor 70) — the floor is ⛔ SHRINK-ONLY" · "JSON phase: 70 fence(s) parsed, 0 failed".
- Mutation leg (objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, WRAP mode, nothing committed): deleting exactly the marker line above the "✅ CORRECT" fence — anchor hit 1 then 0, blob `ffd2a860` then `5138310f`, 12 then 11 marker lines in the file — makes the gate exit 1 with "json: 69 marked fence(s), floor 70 — 1 short" and the script's own remedy text, "⛔ Deleting a marker is not a way to make a red example pass". Restore proven: blob back to `ffd2a860`, equal to HEAD; `git diff HEAD` empty; 12 marker lines.

So the marker is a parse claim that IS enforced, not a check nothing performs. What nothing judges on this surface is strict-face validity — the widening the skills seat deferred, and it is not folded in here. Counts for the record: marker lines directly above json/jsonc fences under `skills/objectui/**` — before 70 (41 json + 29 jsonc), after 70; above ts/tsx/typescript fences — 18, unchanged. The dispatch's own stop threshold (more than 25 json/jsonc markers) is met as well. Removing the markers would need `MARKED_FLOOR` lowered inside the checker, which this PR may not touch; that decision goes back to the seat in the report.

| changeset-guard | `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-pending-changeset-literals.mjs` | 0, 0, 0, 0 | no `major` · no pre-existing changeset modified · every package classified · no test names a pending changeset |
| doc-json (content/docs only; run to confirm it does not read this surface) | `node scripts/check-doc-json-fences.mjs` | 0 | ✅ Every judged JSON node document in the docs passes the strict authoring face · "NOT read: pages outside content/docs/" |
| readers of `protocol.md` | `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/skill-guide-data-table-binding.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/skill-guide-provider-envelope.test.tsx scripts/__tests__/check-skill-examples.test.ts` (under the lock) | 0 | Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 144 passed (144) · VERDICT command-exit 0 |

Not owed, not run: the root `pnpm test` / `pnpm lint` / `type-check` farm (no code changed; the required set — Lint · Type Check · Test shards · Build & E2E · Build Docs · Changeset Declaration — runs on the PR in CI); `check-doc-links.mjs` (its `SCAN_ROOTS` has no `skills` row); `check-doc-fence-languages.mjs`, `check-doc-component-types.mjs`, `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` (`content/docs` and READMEs only). No ablation of a new guard: this PR adds none; the mutation leg above tests the dispatch's mechanism assumption, not a guard of mine.

Line budget, the two readings the dispatch asks for: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` 375 to 376; the bundle (`skills/objectui/**/*.md`, 16 files) 4816 to 4817; `skills/objectui/SKILL.md` 142 to 142. The dispatch expected a net bundle reduction from the marker removal; with the markers kept the bundle is net +1. objectui defines no skill token-count gate, so there is no token reading to report.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not filed: on the "Example violation" fence the strict face's printed first reason is the missing `data`, with `columns` and the undeclared `fields` / `customProp` listed after it. The fence is a deliberate counter-example and is refused on every one of those reasons, so nothing is owed.
- The card's sentence "nothing judges it" about the marker read one constant (`TS_FENCE_LANGUAGES`) and missed `JSON_FENCE_LANGUAGES` three lines below it. The card's core premise — the fence lacks `data`, both faces refuse it — held, and is repaired here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
对外发布的 `skills/objectui` 技能包里,`rules/protocol.md` 「不得发明 spec 之外属性」那条规则下标着「✅ CORRECT」的 `data-table` 示例,补上了 `DataTableSchema` 要求的 `data` 行内数组(一行、一条记录)。另加一个空 frontmatter 的 changeset,声明「不发版」。没有改任何脚本、门禁或标记行。

### 为什么改
这个示例缺了必填的 `data`,`objectui validate`(严格面)和宽容面都拒绝它;agent 照抄技能里标「正确」的示例,写出的却是校验器拒收的节点,反而学到「校验器错了」。用两张 face 重新跑遍技能包全部 70 个 json/jsonc fence:被拒的 9 个里 8 个是刻意写的反例,只有这一个标着「正确」;改后被拒的 8 个全是反例。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
风险极低:一行教学文本,无代码、无发布包。派发令原本还要摘掉 json/jsonc fence 上的 `os:check` 注释标记;实测这个标记被 `scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs` 读取,并有「只减不增」的 70 条下限,摘掉任何一个该门禁就红(已实测:摘一个 → 69/70 → exit 1),所以本 PR 没有摘,留给席位重新裁定。回滚:revert 这一个 commit 即可。

### 席位意见
(留空,席位定稿)

### 你要做的
`skills/**` 是受管面:审阅后留一条 APPROVED review,由派发席翻 ready 并入队;本 PR 不自行入队。顺带裁一个问题:json/jsonc fence 上的 `os:check` 标记是保留(它是一个真实生效的「可解析」声明),还是另开一张卡让 `check-skill-examples.mjs` 用严格面判 json fence 并声明反例 —— 两者都不在本 PR 内。
